Class LiveOrdersViewController

java.lang.Object
view.LiveOrdersViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewController<LiveOrdersViewModel>
public class LiveOrdersViewController extends Object implements ViewController<LiveOrdersViewModel>
JavaFX controller for the Live Orders view. Manages rendering of incoming, current, and finished orders and delegates user actions to the ViewModel.
